name: edu-platform-frontend
description: 教师智能教学系统前端

scripts.build:deploy: vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const ts=Date.now();let h=fs.readFileSync(p.resolve('dist/index.html'),'utf-8');h=h.replace(/(src=\")([^\"]+\.js)(\")/g,(m,a,b,c)=>a+b+'?v='+ts+c);h=h.replace(/(href=\")([^\"]+\.css)(\")/g,(m,a,b,c)=>a+b+'?v='+ts+c);fs.writeFileSync(p.resolve('dist/index.html'),h);console.log('[cache-bust] v='+ts);"
